seo_title: History of JAMMIN’ DJs | Georgia & Tennessee Event Entertainment
seo_description: Learn the history of JAMMIN’ DJs and Infinity Entertainment, from founder Jerry Jodloski to John Murray’s Georgia leadership and more than 10,000 unforgettable performances.
body_html:
Over 10,000 Unforgettable Performances!

John Murray

John Murray started out with JAMMIN’ DJs as a general manager in the Atlanta office, he quickly grew the company to new heights and then relocated to Georgia to expand the company to a new region. While in Georgia John established the Georgia office in 2000. Since then, JAMMIN’ DJs/Infinity Entertainment. has become one of the most recognized and requested entertainment services in Georgia & Georgia. John’s show must go on mentality, and passion for creating memorable events has elevated JAMMIN’ DJs/Infinity Entertainment to an industry leader in multiple states. John has been in the entertainment industry since the age of 16 and has worked for multiple disc jockey companies, night clubs and radio stations. John is currently a Public Address Announcer for the University of Georgia for Men’s Basketball and Football, along with the Georgia Tech Yellow Jackets announcing sports including Men’s Basketball, Women’s Basketball, Baseball, and Volleyball. John was also a former public address announcer for Georgia State University, the world famous Harlem Globetrotters, USA Boxing, Olympic Trials, The Churchill Cup, and more! He has announced in several countries, and over 100 arena’s! He uses his entertainment diversity to expand his business and provide his clients with premier entertainment.

Jerry Jodloski

JAMMIN’ DJs was founded in 1991 after Jerry Jodloski graduated from Michigan State University and decided to start his own business. Since then, the company has become an entertainment powerhouse which continues to expand across the nation. In the early days, Jerry’s experience as a musician and radio disc jockey enhanced his skills for hosting memorable shows while his degree in advertising helped develop the creative and marketing aspects of the business. Solid performances, a bold image and great customer service made JAMMIN’ DJs quickly stand out from the pack. Today, Jerry leads the national headquarters in Lansing, Michigan and owes much of his success to his incredible staff.

 

We are always looking for professional, honest and talented people who are willing to do whatever it takes to provide the best possible service for our clients and their guests. Please contact us if you’d like to become part of the team at JAMMIN’ DJs.

JAMMIN’ DJs and Infinity Entertainment does not and shall not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion (creed), gender, gender expression, age, national origin (ancestry), disability, marital status, sexual orientation, or military status, in any of its activities or operations. These activities include, but are not limited to, hiring and firing of staff, selection of volunteers and vendors, and provision of services. We are committed to providing an inclusive and welcoming environment for all members of our staff, clients, volunteers, subcontractors, vendors, and clients.
